title: Dedekind Poisson Algebras over Arbitrary Fields
summary: We study Poisson algebras in which every Poisson subalgebra is a Poisson ideal, called Dedekind Poisson algebras, over arbitrary fields and without any finite-dimensionality assumption. In characteristic different from 2, combining the two operations by $x*y=xy+[x,y]$ connects the problem with Outcalt's classical classification of power-associative H-algebras and yields the same structural type.
